records.choice: New narration in the lane's guide voice (/opt/hatch/bin/tts, default voice, speed 115 — the voice of WD-01/SOA-01 v3), one file per line, placed on a measured timeline (silencedetect speech spans, START 0.30, inter-line gaps 0.35–0.45, ENDPAD 1.10). The lane's synthesized chord bed sits at voiceRMS −13 dB (measured bed gain −21.60 dB). Mastered via the QC A-08 chain; a music-only twin is mastered alongside for the future voice-clone swap. Wrapped programme = container intro audio + mastered content (incl. the 3.0 s bed-only bridge tail) + outro audio, assembled from WAV sources and encoded to AAC exactly once at MP4 assembly (A-09).
records.alternatives: Re-using another piece's audio — impossible (new script); a different TTS voice — rejected: the lane's voice consistency is the point of a guide voice.
records.context: wd01_i2 audio recipe (the lane template build); A-03/A-08/A-09; masters measured in build_audio.py's log and re-measured on the delivered MP4s at QC (A-07).
records.why: One recipe for the lane: a WD piece's audio should be indistinguishable in method from WD-01's.
records.change: The voice-clone pass swaps narration via the twin, per the standing ladder.

records.choice: Per-line forced alignment: faster-whisper (base, int8) run on each line's OWN TTS file, anchored to that file's silencedetect speech span (span start == the assembled voice.wav window start by construction), script words mapped via difflib; 13 repairs logged in words.json (9 anchor clamps, the 'know-how' 2:1 token merge, 2 heard-word substitutions with timing kept). Validation: 115/115 words inside their constructed line windows, 0 violations.
records.alternatives: The fastlane long-file method (whisper on the assembled voice.wav) — MEASURED AND REJECTED for this build: first-word stamps landed up to 0.84 s before the constructed windows on 6 of 9 lines (whisper stamps an utterance's first word at the preceding segment boundary after long silences). Its output is preserved as words_longfile_v1.json for the record.
records.context: DR-WORD-3's timing rule (re-alignment error >~150 ms matters); the anchor clamps applied here are 0.16–0.20 s — the residual bias of the same artifact, bounded and logged rather than hidden.
records.why: Word pops must land on the voice, not near it; the constructed timeline is ground truth because the assembly placed the audio there.
records.change: A better aligner (or whisper model) that validates to 0 violations on the long file without clamps supersedes this method.

records.choice: Words pop into the planned empty lower band (centres y=1290/1410, alternating), centred at x=530, DejaVu Sans Bold 62px, chalk; key words amber with an overshoot pop. No plate, no band, no subtitle line anywhere in the DOM.
records.alternatives: The v2 caption plate (BANNED, V-16) and the fast-lane caption drawer (the i2/i1 overflow source).
records.context: QC V-16 + V-14 safe rect; the fastlane-v3 template (WD-01/SOA-01 v3) — this piece inherits the lane's placement law unchanged.
records.why: Every beat's artwork is composed in the y 380–1190 zone by design, so the lower band is empty in all 9 beats — words live in the picture's negative space, timed to speech.

records.choice: Phrases of at most 3 words; EVERY phrase group's rendered width is asserted at build time (PIL measurement of the embedded font) at ≤840 px, and re-asserted on live DOM rects + rendered-frame pixel scans at QC. A failed assert stops the build.
records.alternatives: Trusting the layout (the i2/i1 failure mode: WD-01 L5 spanned x 0–1018).
records.context: Final QC defect D-1 (2026-10-23); R-03: the fix belongs in the template, not one piece's numbers.
records.why: Overflow must be impossible by construction, not checked by eye.
records.change: Nothing relaxes this; a wider group needs a smaller font, never a wider rect.

records.choice: Word times from the per-line alignment (DR-ALIGN); words arrive cumulatively inside a phrase (≤3 words), and a completed phrase HOLDS while the next phrase reveals, clearing when the phrase after next starts (C-05 carry-over, JOB DWELL-CONTRAST-FIX 2026-10-25; ≤2 phrases / ≤6 words on screen, alternating bands).
records.alternatives: Whole-line captions (banned) and per-word karaoke over a standing line (a standing line = a subtitle).
records.context: QC V-16 timing rule; phrases_for grouping identical to WD-01 v3.
records.why: At most 3 words exist at any instant, each arriving with its spoken moment.
records.change: Alignment error >~150 ms on any word reopens the method (DR-ALIGN).

records.choice: EVERY display word carries a recorded decision in this file's word_decisions array: its treatment (a choreography tag, the accent pop, or a deliberate AS-IS), its measured tempo (dur to the next word), and its reason. Choreographed: L1 'send.' HOLD (the un-pressed press), L2's three denied verbs SINK, L3 'connection' GROW, L5 'asks' HOLD, L6 'different:' FLIP, L7 'action' SINK + 'words.' SETTLE, L8 'sends,' GROW, L9 'world.' GROWHOLD. The builder ASSERTS coverage — a word without a record fails the build.
records.alternatives: Uniform appearance for all words (captioning behaviour — the named failure); choreographing every word (motion everywhere is noise; stillness is a decision where it serves the beat).
records.context: Word Decision Container doctrine (2026-10-24), as implemented in Ep.3/Ep.4 v4 (160/160, 165/165).
records.why: An unrecorded word is randomness even if it looks fine; the container makes every word's behaviour a choice with a reason.
records.change: Hadi's ear/eye on any word reopens that word's record, not the system.

records.choice: The flagship container (Hadosh Academy intro, SUBSCRIBE outro, series header) rebuilt as HTML components on the same timeline — the MP4 is rendered from this file alone (H-01). Header furniture inside the safe rect.
records.alternatives: The ffmpeg concat wrap (fails H-01 single-source) or dropping the container (changes content).
records.why: One file = the whole video, container included.
records.change: A container redesign applies series-wide, not here.

records.element: Visual beats B1–B9 (HS-07 map + visual plan)
records.choice: One decided event per beat, drawn from the script's HS-07 map and the piece's visual plan (files/short-wd05-visual-plan.png): B1 the finished email + hovering cursor + un-pressed SEND; B2 the sphere emitting words, three doors shut per denied verb; B3 the dashed system ring handing over a glowing connector; B4 the same verbs as three command bars lighting in sequence; B5 request card → the world → report chip; B6 the know-how booklet inside the ring, a dotted guide path out, the world door untouched; B7 the permission gate standing on the connection, the withheld 'tool?' chip, back to word-bubbles; B8 B1's window again with SEND filled and the plane gone, tagged A TOOL ACTED; B9 words → TOOL arrow → the open door. All artwork is lane-grammar schematic (wireframe sphere, doors, cards, glyphs) — the V-13 diagram/symbol exception, as in WD-01; no code-drawn figures of people or things.
records.alternatives: Generated photographic plates (the Earth One lane's grammar) — rejected: the flagship fast lane's visual language is the chalk schematic (WD-01/SOA-01 v3), and lane consistency is a feature viewers navigate by.
records.context: HS-07/HS-08 (provenance: every visual is native to this piece's plan or the lane's grammar); S-05 one signal at a time; V-03 said=shown, beat by beat.
records.why: Frames alone must argue the claim (the sound-off test): words can't → connection → commands → ask/act/report → guidance that never acts → gate → sent → actions.
records.change: The 48 h scoreboard's retention shape, read beat by beat (script DR-2's re-earn map).

records.choice: 3.0 s bridge after the L9 close, bed only (the bed never cuts — CB-01), script §7 verbatim: 'NEXT / Who hands the model its tools? / [the system ring around the sphere] / THE HARNESS — LESSONS / tap to watch →' — routes out of the WD lane to the Lessons playlist. The forward pointer lives in packaging; the arc never needed the word 'harness' (K-01).
records.alternatives: A spoken referral line — rejected: T-16 (the close lands clean first); description-only routing — rejected: it routes nobody from inside the piece.
records.context: T-16; funnel ruling (shorts route onward); WD-01's bridge grammar, with the ring icon in place of the sphere-arrow because THIS piece's destination is the harness, not directions.
records.why: The convinced viewer is owed the route at the moment of conviction.
records.change: Funnel evidence (onward movement) at the 48 h scoreboard.
